title: Shared coefficient presentations of an open restriction cube
statement: For a chosen Cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme; def-pc-fibre-product; def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] and a strict tower coefficient presentation $r$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations], and a scheme map $j:U\to Y$, define $\operatorname{OpenCube}(r,j)$ as the following data. Choose schemes $X_U,Y'_U,X'_U$, maps $j_X,j_{Y'},j_{X'}$ to $X,Y',X'$, and maps $f_U,g_U,f'_U,g'_U$ forming the restricted square. Specify chosen Cartesian structures on the restricted, source, target, base and upper faces. Specify a strict tower coefficient presentation on the restricted square and isomorphisms from $j^{-1}r.RY$, $j_X^{-1}r.RX$, $j_{Y'}^{-1}r.RY'$ and $j_{X'}^{-1}r.RX'$ to its four rings. Require for each of the source, target, base and upper faces that its two composite inverse-image coefficient maps agree, expressed by heterogeneous equality of their native composite coefficient presentations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define sourceFace, targetFace, baseFace and upperFace as strict tower presentations of these four faces, using exactly the specified rings and isomorphisms and the corresponding coherence field. This is data, with no existence assertion or chosen arbitrary witness. The separate openCube_exists theorem supplies it for an open immersion.
